_comment: Upstream facts that a QA check would otherwise report, each with the reason it is accepted. A check fails on anything not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches what it records, so a stale entry cannot hide a new finding.

src/ihris-common/data-lists/4.3.3/curren.reason: ihris-common/modules/Currency/modules/ISO_Currency/ISO_Currency.xml repeats <configurationGroup name="XCD"> and the others once per country that uses the currency (e.g. XCD at lines 120, 145, 1295). I2CE merges same-named groups at one path, so the running system keeps one record; the extraction lists what the XML says. Verified against the MD5-verified 4.3.3 tarball, 2026-09-23.

src/ihris-common/modules/4.3.3/csd-provi.reason: ihris-common/modules/CSD/modules/CSDDataModel/CSD_DataModel.xml registers these as meta/child_forms of csd_facility and csd_organization, and no module of the 4.3.3 release defines a form of that name (it defines, e.g., csd_facility_contact_point). The extraction records what the XML says. Verified against the MD5-verified 4.3.3 tarball, 2026-10-09.
